title: Early Elytras
description: This datapack/mod adds a crafting recipe for elytras using only early game items.
body:
# Early Elytras
This datapack/mod adds an early game crafting recipe for elytras. Yes I know it's unbalanced but it works and this is what it's meant to do. The crafting layout is

```
String Stick String
Leather      Leather
Leather      Leather
```
See gallery for pictures.
[A video of me crafting an elytra and flying](https://streamable.com/o43zaq)
